name: Cheech & Chong - 3 Pack Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Key Lime Pie (H)
description:
Three joints, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Key Lime Pie 3-pack gives you three full-gram pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and cryo-infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light one and go.

Key Lime Pie nails the classic: zesty, tangy lime up front, layered with sweet whipped cream and a buttery graham-crust finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — bright enough for daytime, smooth enough to ride into the evening.

Why you'll love it:

3 × 1G cryo-infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total, quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Key Lime Pie flavor — zesty lime with sweet cream and a buttery crust finish
Hybrid effects — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every pack. Cheech & Chong Key Lime Pie is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
